description: Card `20261105-fixer-9d070c`: `multiverse accounts`'s STATE column reads the open-agent cap (`AccountSelector._availability` check 5 / `accounts.py`'s `_account_state`), not just config/breaker-file state. A seat capped at 1 whose one live agent is `working` must read `at cap: 1/1 open agents` in the STATE column, not `available` — a wrong `available` here is the same class of mistake the breaker read exists to rule out, just for capacity instead of a rate limit. Exactly one `agent list` call is scripted: the STATE column's own cap check and the adjacent `⛁ open: N/cap` line share one resolved live count rather than each asking Herdr separately.

expect.stdout:
ACCOUNT            POOL             STATE        CONFIG DIR
explorer-seat      codex:test       at cap: 1/1 open agents CODEX_HOME=<DIR:codex-home>
                   ⛁ open: 1/1
